description: Mid-conversation the caller asks to be called back by a person; the LLM flags caller_wants_human and we hand off to a callback with whatever we have.

turns.caller: I was in an accident this morning

llm.response_to_caller: I'm sorry to hear that. Let's get you taken care of - your full name?

turns.caller: Actually you know what, can someone just call me back, this is complicated

llm.response_to_caller: Of course - I'll have a Birchwood advisor call you right back.
